Our History

Harborlight Fellowship was started by a handful of fishing families in 1952. The chapel building with its bell tower went up in 1958 and we've been worshipping there ever since. In 2011 we joined with the folks from the old Mariners' Mission and became one family.

Our Pastor

Rev. Richard Albemarle-Soto has served as our pastor since 2015. Before that he was a hospital chaplain for twelve years. He and his wife Joan have three grown kids and one very spoiled beagle.

Worship

Our worship is a blend of old hymns and newer songs. Services usually run a little over an hour. Communion is the first Sunday of every month.

Kids & Youth

Sunday school for kids during worship. Youth group meets... ask Pastor Rick for this season's schedule.
